title: Queries along a choice sequence
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language over its alphabet, let $x$ be an input word, and let $w$ be a finite sequence of choice bits. The list of queries consists of the query strings in the configurations reached from the initial configuration on $x$ after the first $s$ choices, for each $s$ with $0\le s<|w|$ for which the machine is in its query state.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
An oracle language over the machine's alphabet
A finite sequence of choice bits
